chunk.content: Gulamah is processed into salted fish (ikan asin) by small and medium enterprises; the salted-fish gulamah business is documented in Perlis, Berandan Barat, Langkat, North Sumatra.
chunk.source_quote: Shalichaty, S. F., Ratrinia, P. W., & Damanik, S. (2021). BUSINESS ANALYSIS OF GULAMAH (Johnius trachycephalus) SALTED FISH SMALL AND MEDIUM ENTERPRISES (SMEs) IN PERLIS, BERANDAN BARAT, LANGKAT, NORTH SUMATERA. Coastal and Ocean Journal (COJ), 5(1), 1-8.

source.title: Business Analysis of Gulamah (Johnius trachycephalus) Salted Fish Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) in Perlis, Berandan Barat, Langkat, North Sumatera
